places.name: Humboldt Museum
places.description: Local history museum with mammoth bones and an old myth about local giants

places.name: Thousand Creek Gorge
places.description: A spectacular but little-known slot canyon in extreme northern Nevada, with sheer walls nearly 500 feet high and a perennial stream.

places.name: Winnemucca to the Sea Highway Marker
places.description: This giant slab of driftwood marks the beginning of the Winnemucca to the Sea Highway.

places.name: Tobin Range (Pearce) Scarps
places.description: The strongest earthquake in Nevada's recorded history left these spectacular breaks along the west front of a range in central Nevada.

places.name: The Martin Hotel
places.description: It may no longer take overnight guests, but the Martin still makes out-of-towners feel at home—just like it has for the past century.
